sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Mert (because) introduces a reason, placed after the main clause — the same word order as English 'because'.

items.english: I would like the set meal because I'm hungry.

items.spanish: Anna vegetáriánus, de Mariann marhát kér.
items.english: Anna is vegetarian, but Mariann asks for beef.

sections.content: Szeretnék menüt, mert éhes vagyok mirrors the English sentence order: main clause, then mert + reason.
